plan.title: Gender Comparison: Baseline to Endline Improvement
plan.subtitle: Assessing physical fitness and stamina gains across female and male cohorts

panels.title: Total Tracked Children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b."Child ID") AS total_children FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS avg_situps_gain FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS avg_speed_gain FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Average Sit-ups Gain by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT b."Gender" AS gender, AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS avg_situp_gain FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Time Reduction by Gender (Seconds Faster)
panels.sql: SELECT b."Gender" AS gender, AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time_reduction FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Comprehensive Improvement Metrics by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT b."Gender" AS gender, COUNT(b."Child ID") AS students, ROUND(AVG(b."Sit ups"), 2) AS baseline_situps, ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups"), 2) AS endline_situps, ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups"), 2) AS situp_gain, ROUND(AVG(b."Shuttle run sec"), 2) AS baseline_shuttle_sec, ROUND(AVG(e."Shuttle run sec"), 2) AS endline_shuttle_sec, ROUND(AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec"), 2) AS speed_gain_sec, ROUND(AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm"), 2) AS avg_height_growth_cm FROM "baseline" b INNER JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative:
A total of {{p1}} children were evaluated across both baseline and endline assessments. Overall physical performance improved substantially, with an average increase of {{p2}} sit-up repetitions and an average reduction in shuttle run time of {{p3}} seconds.

Comparing outcomes across genders reveals how equitably physical stamina and speed developed. The detailed breakdown shows the baseline and endline progression for both sit-ups and agility shuttle runs.
